ref_text: MINDFUL HOWEVER OF HER OWN ERRORS AND MISFORTUNES SHE EARLY SOUGHT TO IMPOSE A TENDER BUT STRICT CONTROL OVER THE INFANT IMMORTALITY THAT WAS COMMITTED TO HER CHARGE
text: Mindful, however, of her own errors and misfortunes. She early sought to impose a tender but strict control over the infant immortality that was committed to her charge.
